skills_considered.reason: The lot was selected and deduplicated by the Orchestrator's selector against the registries, queue and receipt ledger; the per-paper M0 packet and a scan of staged receipts and peer manifests re-checked it.
No discovery squeeze was warranted: the paper carries no WWOX-deficient datum and its transferable content is carried in the dossier and the analysis note.
No therapeutic lever is matured by this source; forging hypotheses from a class-level, non-WWOX paper would manufacture a lead.
No compound is proposed for a WWOX lever; the BLOCK-1 caution is carried at class level in the dossier.
Scientists do not touch the four current files.
No baseline claim is narrowed, reversed or removed by this reading and no MAJOR bump is declared, so no R4 trigger fires.

group_assessment.weighting: A paediatric nutrition review that the Methods say was registered as an undergraduate thesis at the University of Granada and not in PROSPERO; no primary data; the figures carry an illustration-tool credit. Primary for nothing; a secondary synthesis of 15 mostly external trials.
